title: Sources expect Anthropic's IPO allocation for retail investors to fall below 20%; retail buyers have historically received 5% to 10% of shares in large IPOs (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources expect Anthropic's IPO allocation for retail investors to fall below 20%; retail buyers have historically received 5% to 10% of shares in large IPOs — Frenzy for AI stocks is testing how far Wall Street will go to accommodate a new army of individual investors
